entities.summary: Zoltan Bathory is a Hungarian-American entrepreneur musician and martial artist. He is the founder and rhythm guitarist of Las Vegas-based heavy metal band Five Finger Death Punch. In 2010, he won the Metal Hammer Golden God award for "Best Shredder". Five Finger Death Punch has released nine studio albums and is one of the most successful modern metal bands.
